recognize_zh: 低倍下組織被均一的藍紫色淋巴瘤細胞瀰漫取代，間雜散在淡色的吞噬性巨噬細胞，形成星空樣（starry sky）外觀；這是高增生侵襲性 B 細胞淋巴瘤的低倍線索。
features: Diffuse, monotonous sheet of densely packed lymphoid cells without nodularity
Evenly scattered pale tingible-body macrophages creating a starry-sky pattern
Delicate eosinophilic stromal strands and small vessels coursing through the infiltrate
No residual follicles, sinuses or necrosis in this field
describe_en: Low-power H&E shows complete replacement of the tissue by a diffuse, monotonous sheet of densely packed lymphoid cells with only delicate intervening stromal strands. Evenly distributed tingible-body macrophages produce a starry-sky pattern. No residual follicles or other normal structures are identified, and geographic necrosis is not seen in this field. The appearance indicates a highly proliferative aggressive B-cell lymphoma, including Burkitt lymphoma and high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, which must be separated by immunophenotype and FISH.

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma shows the same starry-sky pattern but is BCL2-negative with a Ki67 near 100% and isolated MYC rearrangement.
DLBCL typically shows larger pleomorphic cells with a less uniform starry sky and lacks double rearrangement.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma can have a starry sky but is composed of TdT-positive blasts.
